  "canonical_python_code": "import numpy as np
from scipy.sparse import diags, eye, kron
from scipy.sparse.linalg import splu


def calibrate_affine_banks(raw_observations: np.ndarray, observation_banks: np.ndarray, reference_levels: np.ndarray, sweep_readouts: np.ndarray, sweep_banks: np.ndarray, *, prior: np.ndarray | None = None, triple_rtol: float = 1e-6) -> np.ndarray:
    """Invert raw = gain * reference + offset for each bank independently.

    Inputs are finite one-dimensional arrays with nonnegative integer bank IDs.
    Prior rows, indexed by bank ID, give (positive gain, offset); without a
    supplied prior use (1, 0). With no sweeps retain both prior parameters.
    If gain is not identified, hold it at the prior and fit offset by median.
    For three sweeps, compare the maximum line residual to triple_rtol times
    the maximum absolute readout. For four or more, screen at 4.5 robust
    scales about a median-residual line and refit its inliers. There is no
    gain penalty on informative sweeps; the sparse fallback fixes the gain.
    """
    raw = np.asarray(raw_observations, dtype=float)
    banks = np.asarray(observation_banks)
    refs = np.asarray(reference_levels, dtype=float)
    reads = np.asarray(sweep_readouts, dtype=float)
    sweep_ids = np.asarray(sweep_banks)
    priors = None if prior is None else np.asarray(prior, dtype=float)
    out = np.empty_like(raw)
    for bank in np.unique(banks):
        rows = banks == bank
        sel = sweep_ids == bank
        x, y = refs[sel], reads[sel]
        gain, offset = (1.0, 0.0) if priors is None else priors[bank]
        if not np.isfinite(gain) or gain <= 0:
            raise ValueError('Prior gains must be finite and positive')
        if x.size:
            offset = float(np.median(y - gain * x))
        span = np.ptp(x) if x.size else 0.0
        if span > 0:
            u = (x - np.median(x)) / span
            v = y - np.median(y)
            keep = np.ones(x.size, dtype=bool)
            if x.size >= 4:
                i, j = np.triu_indices(x.size, 1)
                du = u[j] - u[i]
                distinct = np.abs(du) > 1e-12
                slopes = (v[j[distinct]] - v[i[distinct]]) / du[distinct]
                slopes = slopes[slopes > 0]
                keep[:] = False
                if slopes.size:
                    residuals = v - slopes[:, None] * u
                    errors = np.abs(residuals - np.median(residuals, axis=1)[:, None])
                    scores = np.median(errors, axis=1)
                    best = np.argmin(scores)
                    scale = max(1.4826 * scores[best], 1e-12 * np.ptp(v))
                    keep = errors[best] <= 4.5 * scale
                    if 2 * np.count_nonzero(keep) <= x.size:
                        keep[:] = False
            if np.count_nonzero(keep) >= 2 and np.ptp(u[keep]) > 1e-12:
                uc = u[keep] - u[keep].mean()
                vc = v[keep] - v[keep].mean()
                slope = float((uc @ vc) / (uc @ uc))
                consistent = x.size != 3 or np.max(np.abs(vc - slope * uc)) <= triple_rtol * np.max(np.abs(y))
                if slope > 0 and consistent:
                    gain = slope / span
                    offset = float(y[keep].mean() - gain * x[keep].mean())
        out[rows] = (raw[rows] - offset) / gain
    return out


def separable_transport_design(lengths: tuple[float, float], diffusivities: tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray], velocities: tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray], robin: tuple[float, float], baseline_reactions: tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray], reaction_field: np.ndarray, source_modes: np.ndarray, shifts: np.ndarray, sensor_indices: np.ndarray, *, separability_rtol: float = 1e-10) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Solve shifted transport on a uniform cell-centered rectangle.

    Use harmonic face diffusion, row-wise first-order upwinding of velocity
    times the gradient, and one Robin transfer coefficient per axis, shared
    by its two ends. The separable added reaction supplements the independent
    axis baselines. Diffusivity has units L^2/T, velocity and transfer L/T,
    and reactions and shifts 1/T. Source modes have shape (M, nx, ny) and
    units of field per time. Each shifted system must be invertible; no
    forward regularization is added. Return shift-first sensor rows and
    last-shift fields shaped (nx, ny, M).
    """
    reaction = np.asarray(reaction_field, dtype=float)
    modes = np.asarray(source_modes, dtype=float)
    shifts = np.asarray(shifts, dtype=float)
    nx, ny = reaction.shape
    if min(nx, ny) < 1 or modes.ndim != 3 or modes.shape[1:] != reaction.shape or shifts.ndim != 1 or not shifts.size:
        raise ValueError('Supply a nonempty grid, grid-shaped modes and a vector of shifts')
    rx = reaction.mean(axis=1)
    ry = reaction.mean(axis=0) - reaction.mean()
    defect = reaction - (rx[:, None] + ry[None, :])
    if np.max(np.abs(defect)) > separability_rtol * np.max(np.abs(reaction)):
        raise ValueError('Added reaction field is not separable')
    operators = []
    for axis, (n, extra) in enumerate(((nx, rx), (ny, ry))):
        length = lengths[axis]
        k = np.asarray(diffusivities[axis], dtype=float)
        v = np.asarray(velocities[axis], dtype=float)
        base = np.asarray(baseline_reactions[axis], dtype=float)
        transfer = robin[axis]
        if k.shape != (n,) or v.shape != (n,) or base.shape != (n,):
            raise ValueError('Axis coefficients must have one value per cell')
        if length <= 0 or np.any(k <= 0) or transfer < 0:
            raise ValueError('Require positive length and diffusivity and nonnegative Robin transfer')
        h = 1.0 / n
        k = k / length**2
        v = v / length
        transfer = transfer / length
        p = np.maximum(v, 0) / h
        m = np.maximum(-v, 0) / h
        q = (2 * k[:-1] * k[1:] / (k[:-1] + k[1:])) / h**2
        main = base + extra + p + m
        main[:-1] += q
        main[1:] += q
        ends = np.array([0, n - 1])
        np.add.at(main, ends, transfer * k[ends] / (h * (transfer * h / 2 + k[ends])))
        if n == 1:
            operators.append(diags([main], [0], format='csc'))
        else:
            operators.append(diags([-q - p[1:], main, -q - m[:-1]], [-1, 0, 1], format='csc'))
    ax, by = operators
    op = (kron(ax, eye(ny)) + kron(eye(nx), by)).tocsc()
    identity = eye(nx * ny, format='csc')
    rhs = modes.reshape(modes.shape[0], nx * ny).T
    i, j = np.asarray(sensor_indices).T
    rows = []
    for shift in shifts:
        field = splu(op + shift * identity).solve(rhs).reshape(nx, ny, modes.shape[0])
        rows.append(field[i, j])
    return np.concatenate(rows, axis=0), field


def fit_box_simplex_path(design: np.ndarray, observations: np.ndarray, nuisance: np.ndarray, *, cap: float, budgets: np.ndarray, source_ridge: float, nuisance_ridge: float = 0.0) -> tuple[np.ndarray, list[dict[str, float | np.ndarray]]]:
    """Fit bounded nonnegative source weights at each fixed sum, in input order.

    Apply the direct ridge-fit residual operator to both the design and the
    data, then minimize half the squared residual plus half source_ridge times
    the squared weight norm. Zero nuisance ridge (default) is least-squares
    projection; use shape (n_rows, 0) for no nuisance. Source ridge is required
    and positive. The ridges have units of the corresponding squared column
    norms. The active-set gradient tolerance is 1e-12 after normalization.
    Certificates use g - nu_sum - lam_lower + lam_upper = 0 and a tangent
    lower bound on the objective over the feasible box and sum constraint.
    """
    D = np.asarray(design, dtype=float)
    y = np.asarray(observations, dtype=float)
    Z = np.asarray(nuisance, dtype=float)
    totals = np.asarray(budgets, dtype=float)
    if D.ndim != 2 or y.shape != (D.shape[0],) or Z.ndim != 2 or Z.shape[0] != D.shape[0]:
        raise ValueError('Design, observations and nuisance must share rows')
    n = D.shape[1]
    if n == 0 or cap <= 0 or totals.ndim != 1 or not totals.size or not np.all((totals >= 0) & (totals <= n * cap)):
        raise ValueError('Supply feasible budgets for a positive box cap')
    if source_ridge <= 0 or nuisance_ridge < 0:
        raise ValueError('Require positive source ridge and nonnegative nuisance ridge')
    data = np.column_stack((D, y))
    if Z.shape[1]:
        if nuisance_ridge == 0:
            data -= Z @ np.linalg.lstsq(Z, data, rcond=None)[0]
        else:
            U, s, _ = np.linalg.svd(Z, full_matrices=False)
            data -= U @ ((s**2 / (s**2 + nuisance_ridge))[:, None] * (U.T @ data))
    S, r = data[:, :-1], data[:, -1]
    A = cap * S
    H = A.T @ A + source_ridge * cap**2 * np.eye(n)
    c = -(A.T @ r)
    scale = max(np.max(np.abs(H)), np.max(np.abs(c)))
    H, c = H / scale, c / scale
    weights, certificates = [], []
    for budget in totals:
        if budget == 0:
            x, nu = np.zeros(n), np.min(c)
        elif budget == n * cap:
            x = np.ones(n)
            nu = np.max(H @ x + c)
        else:
            x = np.full(n, budget / (n * cap))
            state = np.zeros(n, dtype=int)
            for _ in range(100 * n):
                g = H @ x + c
                free = np.flatnonzero(state == 0)
                if not free.size:
                    lo = np.argmin(np.where(state < 0, g, np.inf))
                    hi = np.argmax(np.where(state > 0, g, -np.inf))
                    if g[hi] - g[lo] <= 1e-12:
                        nu = (g[hi] + g[lo]) / 2
                        break
                    state[[lo, hi]] = 0
                    continue
                block = H[np.ix_(free, free)]
                a, b = np.linalg.solve(block, np.column_stack((g[free], np.ones(free.size)))).T
                nu = a.sum() / b.sum()
                step = nu * b - a
                alpha = np.full(free.size, np.inf)
                np.divide(1 - x[free], step, out=alpha, where=step > 1e-14)
                np.divide(-x[free], step, out=alpha, where=step < -1e-14)
                hit = np.argmin(alpha)
                if alpha[hit] < 1:
                    x[free] += max(0.0, alpha[hit]) * step
                    idx = free[hit]
                    state[idx] = 1 if step[hit] > 0 else -1
                    x[idx] = float(state[idx] > 0)
                    continue
                x[free] += step
                violation = state * (H @ x + c - nu)
                release = np.argmax(violation)
                if violation[release] <= 1e-12:
                    break
                state[release] = 0
            else:
                raise RuntimeError('Box-simplex active set did not converge')
        w = cap * np.clip(x, 0, 1)
        nu_sum = float(nu * scale / cap)
        residual = S @ w - r
        g = S.T @ residual + source_ridge * w
        lower = np.maximum(g - nu_sum, 0)
        upper = np.maximum(nu_sum - g, 0)
        primal = float(0.5 * (residual @ residual + source_ridge * (w @ w)))
        bound = primal + nu_sum * (budget - w.sum()) - lower @ w - upper @ (cap - w)
        weights.append(w)
        certificates.append({'nu_sum': nu_sum, 'lam_lower': lower, 'lam_upper': upper,
                             'primal_objective': primal, 'dual_lower_bound': float(bound)})
    return np.stack(weights), certificates

def run_self_test():
    close = np.testing.assert_allclose
    lengths = (2., 4.)
    k = (np.array([1., 3.]), np.array([2., 6.]))
    v = (np.array([-.4, .2]), np.array([.6, .2]))
    robin = (.5, .4)
    base = (np.array([.2, .6]), np.array([.4, .1]))
    reaction = np.array([.1, .3])[:, None] + np.array([-.05, .05])
    shifts = np.array([.2, .8])
    sensors = np.array([[1, 1], [0, 0], [1, 0], [0, 1]])
    # Independent physical stencils, including heterogeneous faces and Robin endpoints.
    Ax = np.array([[1.5 + .4 + .4 + .2 + .1, -1.9], [-1.7, 1.5 + .2 + 6/13 + .6 + .3]])
    By = np.array([[.75 + .3 + 1/6 + .4 - .05, -.75], [-.85, .75 + .1 + .1875 + .1 + .05]])
    truth = np.array([[[1., 0., 0.], [0., 2., 0.]], [[0., 0., 3.], [1., -1., .5]]])
    modes = np.stack([Ax @ u + u @ By.T + shifts[-1] * u for u in truth.transpose(2, 0, 1)])
    D, terminal = separable_transport_design(lengths, k, v, robin, base, reaction, modes, shifts, sensors)
    close(terminal, truth, atol=2e-12)
    op = np.kron(Ax, np.eye(2)) + np.kron(np.eye(2), By)
    first = np.linalg.solve(op + shifts[0] * np.eye(4), modes.reshape(3, 4).T).reshape(2, 2, 3)
    i, j = sensors.T
    close(D, np.vstack((first[i, j], truth[i, j])), atol=2e-12)

    # Change length units, double the rate scale, exchange axes, and reorder sensors.
    # This grid has cell indices, not directed sensor-pair edges or a wave carrier.
    l, rate = .01, 2.
    perm = np.array([2, 0, 3, 1])
    row_perm = np.r_[perm, len(sensors) + perm]
    Ds, ts = separable_transport_design(
        tuple(l*a for a in lengths[::-1]), tuple(l*l*rate*a for a in k[::-1]),
        tuple(l*rate*a for a in v[::-1]), tuple(l*rate*a for a in robin[::-1]),
        tuple(rate*a for a in base[::-1]), rate*reaction.T, rate*modes.transpose(0, 2, 1),
        rate*shifts, sensors[perm, ::-1])
    close(Ds, D[row_perm], atol=2e-12)
    close(ts.transpose(1, 0, 2), truth, atol=2e-12)

    # Clean triple, corrupted triple, screened quartet, single reference, and no sweep.
    banks = np.array([0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 2, 0, 1])
    gain = np.array([1.6, .75, 1.2, 1.8, .9])
    offset = np.array([.2, -.1, .3, .5, -.3])
    prior = np.array([[1., 0.], [.75, 4.], [1., 0.], [1.8, 4.], [.9, -.3]])
    sb = np.repeat(np.arange(4), [3, 3, 4, 1])
    refs = np.array([-1., 0., 2., -2., 0., 2., -2., -1., 1., 2., 1.])
    reads = gain[sb]*refs + offset[sb]
    reads[[4, 8]] += [40., -25.]

    # Construct observations with exact KKT gradient signs at the middle budget.
    w_true = np.array([0., .4, .6])
    cap, ridge = .6, .2
    budgets = np.array([0., 1., 3*cap])
    Z = np.zeros((len(D), 1)); Z[0, 0] = 1.
    d = np.ones(len(D)); d[0] = .5  # Direct ridge residual operator, not its square root.
    g_true = np.array([.3, .1, -.2])
    e = np.linalg.lstsq(D.T * d**2, g_true - ridge*w_true, rcond=None)[0]
    y = D @ w_true - e
    raw = gain[banks]*y + offset[banks]
    calibrated = calibrate_affine_banks(raw, banks, refs, reads, sb, prior=prior)
    close(calibrated, y, atol=2e-12)
    scale = 1e-3
    ps = prior.copy(); ps[:, 1] *= scale
    cs = calibrate_affine_banks(scale*raw[row_perm], banks[row_perm], scale*refs[::-1], scale*reads[::-1], sb[::-1], prior=ps)
    close(cs, scale*y[row_perm], atol=2e-14)

    w, certs = fit_box_simplex_path(D, calibrated, Z, cap=cap, budgets=budgets, source_ridge=ridge, nuisance_ridge=1.)
    close(w, np.vstack((np.zeros(3), w_true, np.full(3, cap))), atol=2e-11)
    close(w.sum(axis=1), budgets, atol=2e-12)
    close(terminal @ w[1], truth @ w_true, atol=2e-11)
    S, r = D*d[:, None], y*d
    for total, weights, cert in zip(budgets, w, certs):
        lo, hi, nu = cert['lam_lower'], cert['lam_upper'], cert['nu_sum']
        g = S.T @ (S @ weights - r) + ridge*weights
        assert np.all(lo >= 0) and np.all(hi >= 0)
        close(weights.sum(), total, atol=2e-12)
        close(g - nu - lo + hi, 0., atol=2e-11)
        close(lo*weights + hi*(cap - weights), 0., atol=2e-11)
        close(cert['dual_lower_bound'], cert['primal_objective'], atol=2e-11)
    close(certs[1]['nu_sum'], .1, atol=2e-11)
    close(certs[1]['lam_lower'], [.2, 0., 0.], atol=2e-11)
    close(certs[1]['lam_upper'], [0., 0., .3], atol=2e-11)
    objective = .5 * (np.linalg.norm(d*e)**2 + ridge*(w_true @ w_true))
    close(certs[1]['primal_objective'], objective, atol=2e-12)
    ws, scerts = fit_box_simplex_path(scale*Ds, cs, Z[row_perm], cap=cap, budgets=budgets,
                                      source_ridge=scale**2*ridge, nuisance_ridge=1.)
    close(ws, w, atol=2e-11)
    close(scerts[1]['primal_objective'] / scale**2, objective, atol=2e-12)
    for array in (D, terminal, Ds, ts, calibrated, cs, w, ws):
        assert np.isfinite(array).all()
    for cert in certs + scerts:
        assert all(np.isfinite(value).all() for value in cert.values())


run_self_test()
